name: Patrick Walsh

bio.statement: Walsh's pamphlet statement lists a communications and theater BA from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst.
bio.excerpt: University of Massachusetts at Amherst, Communications & Theater, BA

bio.statement: Walsh's pamphlet statement lists service as chair of the Lake Oswego Library Advisory Board.
bio.excerpt: Chair, Lake Oswego Library Advisory Board (Member 2022-present; Chair 2025-Present);

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Walsh lists smart, transparent management of public funds.
positions.excerpt: Smart, transparent management of public funds.

positions.statement: Walsh's pamphlet statement prioritizes core infrastructure, including roads, clean water, pedestrian pathways and emergency services.

positions.statement: Walsh's pamphlet statement says he will host regular constituent office hours and keep communication open.

positions.statement: Walsh's pamphlet statement says the council should reflect and listen to the community.
positions.excerpt: Our Council should always reflect and listen to our community.

positions.statement: Walsh's campaign site lists supporting first responders to maintain a safe, welcoming city.
positions.excerpt: Supporting our first responders to maintain a safe, welcoming city.
